Watch out!
Pokemon are hiding in the grass!
I heard you can find pokemon from Johto in this route sometimes...but I hate grinding... in tall grass!

action.text: Hi there! Have you heard of the promotion we're doing? Here's a free sample!
How're those samples treating you? Make sure you visit us in Viridian City!

properties.dialogue: I'm really just here to keep an eye on things since a lot of rookies congregate here!
Route 2 connects Viridian City to Viridian Forest. Wild Pokemon thrive in the tall grass — stay alert!

Diglett's Cave runs beneath Route 2 all the way to Vermillion City. A handy shortcut for travelers!
PokeCenter's are free to visit!
Pewter Museum of Science -- Exhibits on Pokemon evolution and fossils now open!
Pewter City Gym -- Leader Brock -- The Rock-Solid type specialist. Grass-types and Water-types are your best bet!
Route 3 & Mt. Moon ahead! Stock up on Potions and Escape Ropes before venturing into the caves.
Signs are useful, aren't they?

Technology is incredible! 
You can now store and recall items and Pokemon as data via PC.

Viridian Forest lies just north of town.
Watch your step — Bug-types love the tall grass!
Young Gym Guide Riley by the crossroads can tell you more.

action.text: Welcome to Viridian City! I'm Riley, the gym scout.
Our Gym Leader is away for now. Train up and challenge Brock in Pewter City first!
Old Man Alden by the west path knows every shortcut through Viridian Forest.
Still getting stronger? Keep at it! Hank near the plaza gives out berries to newcomers.
You earned the Boulder Badge! Our Gym Leader should be back soon. You're ready for whatever comes next!
Oh! You've got that look about you — someone itching to feel a tug on the line. I can always tell.
I've fished this little Viridian pond since I was knee-high. A big Magikarp splashed right there this very morning!
Every angler has to start somewhere. Here — take my old spare. It's been rattling around my tackle box for years.
Fiona handed you a Rusty Rod!
She's rusty and she creaks, but she'll pull 'em in just fine. Face the water, wait for a ripple, then cast!
Start right here at the pond — the little ones go easy on a beginner. Come show me your first catch, won't you?
How's that Rusty Rod treating you? Don't let the creaking fool you — she's landed me plenty of dinners.
Face the water and wait for a ripple, then cast. This pond's calmest at dawn, if you ask me.
Hey, welcome to Viridian City! I'm Hank — born and raised here.
Take these Oran Berries. A Route 1 mart rep got me hooked on handing out samples too!
Enjoy! Fiona by the eastern pond swears by fishing at dawn.
Stock up at the Poké Mart when you can. Riley by the crossroads tracks who's ready for the Gym!

properties.dialogue: Nothing beats my morning walk through Route 2. Keeps me young!

action.text: Greetings Traveler! This roadway leads into Viridian Forest.
Through Viridian Forest, you'll eventually reach the other side of Route 2.
This leads to Pewter City... the home of the first Gym Leader, Brock! He's a rock-hard leader. Don't underestimate him!

properties.dialogue: Diglett's Cave entrance is just west of here. Goes straight to Vermillion City — beats walking through Routes 5 and 6!
Pewter City is just north through the trees. Brock's Gym is tough — make sure you're ready!

action.text: Welcome to Pewter City! Home of the Rock-type Gym Leader, Brock. His Onix is no joke — I've seen it topple trees!
If you're planning to challenge him, make sure you've got Water- or Grass-type moves. Or better yet, both!
Hi there! I just picked up some new Poke Balls from the Mart. They've got the best deals in town!
Make sure you stock up before heading to the Gym. You don't want to run out of Potions mid-battle!
I've been training my Pokemon all week! I caught a Mankey near Route 2 and it's learning new moves every day!
Brock's Rock-types are tough, but my Mankey's Fighting moves should give him a run for his money!
The Pewter Museum of Science is famous for its fossil exhibit. They've got specimens of ancient Pokemon that once roamed Kanto!
Rumor has it there's a lab that can revive fossils into living Pokemon. Now THAT would be something to see!

properties.dialogue:
ROUTE 3
Mt. Moon Ahead — Beware of wild Pokemon in the tall grass!
Mt. Moon's up ahead. Used to be a meteorite impact site — now it's full of Zubat and Geodude. Bring lots of Repel!

action.text: Have you noticed the migrational patterns of Pokemon
have caused there to be an increasing shift of Pokemon normally native to Johto appearing within Kanto.

properties.dialogue: Molly's Garden. Don't step on the flowers!
MT. MOON — EAST EXIT. Cerulean City lies just ahead down the mountain path.

action.text: MT. MOON — Beware of wild Zubat. They flock in the darkness and attack without warning. Travelers should bring plenty of Poké Balls.

properties.dialogue: Mt. Moon -- Named for the Clefairy sighted here.

action.text: CERULEAN CITY POKEMON GYM — Leader: Misty — The Tomboyish Mermaid!

properties.dialogue: Cerulean City Gym -- Leader Misty -- The Bright-Eyed Swimming Star!
CERULEAN CITY — A Mysterious Blue Aura Surrounds It
MIRACLE CYCLE — Ride in style!
Bill's House
Underground Path - Direct to Vermilion City
Power Plant
South to Saffron City. Due to Team Rocket Presence. Saffron is off limits.
What a view! You can see all the way to Cerulean City from up here. The fresh mountain air makes my Pokemon so full of energy. We have a picnic here every weekend — best spot in all of Kanto!

action.text: Made it through Mt. Moon, eh? Most trainers give up about halfway in. You've got guts, kid. Just don't get too cocky — Cerulean City's Gym Leader Misty is tough as nails. Her Water types will drown you if you're not ready.
Hisssss.....Hissssss.....I'm a snake! My favorite Pokemon is Ekans! My mom won't let me be a trainer yet, but someday, I'm going to have the bestest snake ever!
Neo, Please Edit This Later
Already gave you the TM. Shadow Ball — don't overthink it. Get it on a special attacker and let it rip. Ghost types get STAB too, so keep that in mind.

properties.dialogue: How peculiar... The Resource Nodes appear unstable. I must continue my investigation!
Welcome to Viridian City!
Hi! Welcome to Vermilion City!

action.text: My dad was working on a new building on this very plot of land.
Sadly, he passed away last month.
His Machamp still comes by every day.
